name: Ring of Emotional Impact
body:
Price 48,000 gp; Aura moderate evocation; CL 10th; Slot ring; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This ring is made of strange skymetals and inscribed with inscrutable runes that glow with a unique color when the ring is used. Each ring is keyed to a specific emotional focus available to a spiritualist’s phantom. Three times per day, the wearer of the ring can use force punch as a spell like ability at caster level 10th, applying an additional effect based on the ring’s emotional focus, as follows. The DC for this effect is equal to 13 + the wearer’s Wisdom modifier.

Anger: If the target fails its save, roll d6s for damage instead of d4s. Color: Crimson.
Dedication: If the target fails its save, you gain a +4 bonus to your AC 32 against that creature for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting emotion effect. Color: Blue.
Despair: If the target fails its save, it takes a –2 penalty to attack and damage rolls for 1 round. This is a mind-affecting emotion effect. Color: Amber.
Desperation: Once per day, if a target succeeds at its save, you can force them to roll that saving throw again with a –2 penalty. Color: Chartreuse.
Fear: If the target fails its save, it becomes shaken for 1d4 rounds. This is a mind-affecting fear effect. Color: Yellow.
Greed: If the target fails its save, you can choose to pull the target closer to you the same amount of distance you could push them away (your choice). Color: Orange.
Hatred: If you target the creature that most recently harmed you, that creature receives a –2 penalty to its saving throw and takes +1 damage per die on a failed save. Color: Blood Red.
Jealousy: If the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC, it does not receive a saving throw and takes +1 damage per die. Color: Pink.
Kindness: If the target fails its save, all of your allies within 60 feet of you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls against that target for 1 round. Color: Indigo.
Lust: If the target fails its save, you can choose to make the target staggered for 1 round instead of pushing it. This is a mind-affecting effect. Color: Purple.
Pride: If the target fails its save, the distance it is pushed is doubled. Color: Green.
Remorse: If the target fails its save, you can choose to make the target lose its Dexterity bonus to AC for 1 round instead of pushing it. This is a mind-affecting emotion effect. Color: Gray.
Suffering: If the target fails its save, it also takes 1 point of bleed damage per die. This is an emotion effect. Color: Plum.
Whimsy: If the target fails its save, you can choose to make the target prone instead of pushing it. (If the creature has more than two legs, it must fail its save by 2 for every extra leg it has, or this effect fails. Creatures immune to tripping cannot be forced prone.) Color: Magenta.
Zeal: If the target fails its save by 5 or more, the damage of the spell is doubled. Color: Cyan.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells force punch, spirit-bound blade; Cost 24,000 gp

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
